Plan Your Trip
Refer & earn

Share the adventure, reap the rewards

$100 in your pocket every time a friend books, an exclusive experience after three, and a perk for them as well.

How it works

Everybody wins

Earn $100 in cash

$100 every time someone you refer books a trip with me. No cap — refer as many friends as you like.

Your friend gets a treat, too

They receive something extra on their trip — a bottle of champagne in the room, a spa credit, or a special excursion.

Start referring

Send a friend my way

Two ways to do it, and both take about a minute.

Use the referral form

Give me your details and theirs, and I'll reach out to your friend directly — mentioning you sent me, so they know it isn't a cold call.

Refer a friend

Or just introduce us

An email introduction works just as well, and some people prefer it. Copy me in and I'll take it from there.

Email an introduction

The small print, in plain terms

  • The $100 is paid once your friend's trip is booked and traveled — that's when I'm paid, so that's when I can pay you.
  • Your friend needs to be new to me. If they're already a client, the referral doesn't apply.
  • The three-referral experience is based on three separate friends who book and travel, not three bookings by the same person.
  • Their perk depends on what they book — I'll match it to the trip rather than force a bottle of champagne on someone who doesn't drink.
